facts.fact: The Ministry of Communications issued the National Broadband Policy and Implementation Strategy as Final Version 1.0 in October 2012, setting targets of 40% household and 40% national broadband penetration by 2015 and 90% by 2020; the passages do not state a cabinet adoption date, so the document's published date is used.
